data.title: Commodity Corner: Oil steady amid US-Iran tensions; gold rebounds from 14-month low
data.description:
Commodity markets traded higher on November 19, with crude oil prices steady as investors assessed the outlook for the US-Iran conflict and the possibility of fresh attacks on Tehran. Meanwhile, gold recovered from a 14-month low as dip buying provided support despite growing expectations of a potential US Federal Reserve interest rate hike.

Oil steadied as traders assessed the outlook for the US-Iran conflict, including the possibility of fresh attacks against Tehran.

Brent held near $92 a barrel after losing 1.3% on Wednesday, while West Texas Intermediate was above $83.

Gold climbed from a 14-month low as dip buyers helped cushion growing expectations that the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates.

Bullion gained as much as 0.8% to near $3,755 an ounce, recovering some of a 3.2% decline Wednesday that dragged the

metal to its lowest close since September 2025.

Among other precious metals, silver gained 1.6% to $45.79 an ounce, after sinking nearly 5% in the previous session to its lowest close since September 2025. Platinum and palladium also advanced.

The US dollar hovered near a 19-month high on Thursday after Federal Reserve meeting minutes and hawkish comments from a Fed official pointed to further interest rate hikes.

The dollar index was roughly flat at 103.81 in early Asia trade, hovering near its highest level since April 2025.

data.title: Talisker Provides Ore Sorter Facility Construction Update for the Bralorne Gold Project
data.description:
TORONTO, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Talisker Resources Ltd. ("Talisker" or the "Company") (TSX: TSK, OTCQX: TSKFF) is pleased to provide an update on the continued advancement of its ore sorter facility (“Sorting Facility”) at the Company’s 100% owned Bralorne Gold Project (“Bralorne”). Construction and engineering activities have continued to advance according to plan, with several major project milestones already completed and a number of critical work programs now entering the execution phase.

Key Highlights:

  • Initial operation of the Sorting Facility is targeted for Q2 2027, with full commissioning expected in July-August 2027.
  • Electrical infrastructure is completed and targeted for commissioning by the end of November 2026, providing power for the future operation of the Sorting Facility.
  • Phase 1 earthworks associated with the electrical infrastructure required to support the Sorting Facility were successfully completed in September.
  • Phase 2 earthworks and concrete foundation construction is planned to commence late November 2026, following removal of legacy infrastructure.
  • Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) of the TOMRA XRT Sorter is scheduled for early December 2026, with the ore sorter expected to arrive in Canada in January 2027.
  • Major long-lead equipment procurement is substantially complete, with the jaw crusher, cone crusher, vibrating screen plant received in Bralorne in October, conveyors, compressors, and buildings being delivered in phases starting December 2026.
  • Construction and mechanical installation activities are planned throughout Q1 2027, supported by completion of detailed engineering and issuance of the remaining construction tender packages in December 2026.

Phase 1 earthworks associated with the electrical infrastructure required to support the Sorter Facility was successfully completed in September. The electrical infrastructure has been procured and installed, with final commissioning scheduled for the end of November 2026. The Mustang Mine power generation and distribution system consists of two 1.5 MW diesel generators, providing a total installed generation capacity of 3 MW at 600 V. The generators can operate in parallel or independently, providing redundancy and backup capability.

Power for the underground mining operations is stepped up to 4.16 kV through a 3,200 kVA transformer and distributed to underground substations that will supply mining equipment.

Surface power distribution is installed and ready to serve the sorting and crushing facilities, as well as supporting all other surface infrastructure requirements. The electrical system incorporates protective switchgear, circuit breakers, ground-fault monitoring, and neutral grounding resistors to ensure safe and reliable operation during the next phase of project development. The power plant and distribution network have also been designed to accommodate the future addition of a third generator unit, allowing for straightforward expansion of site power capacity as operational requirements increase.

As part of the ore sorter site preparation activities, a legacy electrical system located within the planned Sorting Facility footprint has been safely dismantled and removed, clearing part of the area for Phase 2 Earthworks construction. In parallel, the Company has completed construction of a new tension-fabric steel frame heavy-duty mechanic shop and is currently transitioning operations from the legacy shop. Demolition of the former shop is expected to be completed in November, fully opening the sorter site for Phase 2 Earthworks before the end of November.

The Phase 2 Earthworks and concrete contractor is scheduled to mobilize to site in November, marking the beginning of a major construction phase. This work will include cut-and-fill activities, foundation preparation, and pre-cast concrete installation within the area previously occupied by the legacy electrical infrastructure and mechanic shop.

Detailed engineering for the project continues to progress well. Issue-for-Tender packages covering the remaining construction components including equipment installation, electrical and mechanical are expected to be completed in December 2026, positioning the project for construction execution through the first half of 2027.

Procurement efforts have been highly successful, with all major equipment purchased. Equipment is either in manufacturing or pending delivery. A proactive approach to early procurement has significantly de-risked the project schedule and supports the Company's objective of maintaining construction momentum throughout the coming months.

A key milestone will occur during the second week of December when the Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) is conducted for the TOMRA XRT sorter. Following successful testing, the ore sorter is expected to arrive in Canada in January 2027.

The crushing circuit has also reached an important milestone, with all major crushing equipment including the jaw crusher, cone crusher, and vibrating screen plant, now delivered and in Bralorne. The compressor system required to support sorter operations is expected to ship for delivery in January 2027.

Building fabrication remains on track, with the manufacturing of two tension-fabric steel frame buildings completed and ready for shipment. The remaining two buildings are expected to be completed and shipped in January 2027.

Engineering and fabrication of the conveyor systems is progressing well. Initial conveyor deliveries are expected to begin arriving on site in mid-December, with additional conveyors being manufactured and shipped in priority sequence throughout the first quarter of 2027.

Taken together, these achievements represent substantial progress toward delivery of one of the Company's most important infrastructure projects. The project continues to transition from planning into full-scale execution with detailed engineering, procurement, and construction activities advancing simultaneously.

The Sorting Facility remains on schedule for operational readiness in the second quarter of 2027, with full commissioning anticipated during July-August 2027. Pre-commissioning activities will involve sorting existing stockpile inventory, providing an opportunity to validate system performance ahead of full scale operations. Once operational, the Sorting Facility will process run-of-mine material and is expected to enhance gold grades while eliminating dilution prior to trucking and shipping, improve operating efficiencies, reduce transportation costs, and strengthen project economics.

Terry Harbort, President and CEO, stated, "We are very pleased with the progress being made on the Sorting Facility. With key infrastructure completed, major equipment secured, and construction activities continuing to ramp up, the project remains on schedule for operational readiness in Q2 2027. This Sorting Facility represents an important milestone for Bralorne and will play a significant role in improving operational efficiency and supporting the Company's long-term growth objectives."

Figure 1: Aerial view of the Mustang Mine site with a rendered overlay of the sorting facility. The recently completed machine shop and the Mustang Mine power generation systems are shown to scale in their actual locations. The Sorting Facility rendering is provided for conceptual illustration only and may not be to scale. The product sorting process flow is indicated by the gold arrows, with major sorting equipment labelled in sequence from 1 through 4.

Figure 2: 3D rendering of the Sorting Facility. The product sorting process flow is indicated by the gold arrows, with major sorting equipment labelled in sequence. Run-of-mine material is loaded into the jaw crusher (1) via the loading ramp and conveyed to the triple-deck screening plant (2). Screened material is then transported to the TOMRA XRT sorter (3), where gold-bearing material is separated from waste rock. The sorted product is conveyed to the cone crusher (4) before being stockpiled within a covered tension-fabric storage building. Waste reject material is conveyed to a separate waste stockpile.

Figure 3: Mustang Mine and Sorting Facility Power Generation System will power all Mustang Operations including the ore sorter, with 100% redundancy.

Figure 4: Left, the Mustang Mine and Sorter Facility power generation system in the foreground, and the new tension-fabric steel frame mechanic shop in the centre background. Right, the new Mustang Mine Mechanic shop.

Figure 5: The Jaw Crusher, Cone Crusher, vibrating screen plant and all crushing circuit equipment frames arrived in Bralorne in October. Installation of the crushing circuit is expected to commence in Q1 2027.

data.title: South Korean shares fall as hawkish Fed dents risk sentiment
data.description:
Key points:
  • KOSPI falls, foreigners net sellers
  • Korean won strengthens against dollar
  • South Korea benchmark bond yield falls

Round-up of South Korean financial markets:

** South Korean shares fell more than 1% on Thursday after hawkish remarks from US Federal Reserve officials reinforced expectations that interest rates could stay higher for longer.

** The benchmark KOSPI was down 55.85 points, or 1.10%, at 5,011.59, as of 0156 GMT.

** Fed officials saw a growing risk last month that they might need to intensify their efforts to control inflation, even as they agreed to keep interest rates steady for the moment, the minutes of their October 27-28 meeting showed on Wednesday.

** Fed governor Christopher Waller said the US central bank needs to get more aggressive in its response to inflation that he fears is changing public psychology about prices, and either approve a half-point hike at the December meeting or communicate a faster pace of hikes in 2027.

** "The domestic market is falling on Nvidia cutting earlier gains overnight, pressure from hawkish comments by Fed officials and caution over Anthropic's IPO," said Han Ji-young, an analyst at Kiwoom Securities.

** Anthropic's IPO raised $81.31 billion on Wednesday, eclipsing SpaceX's offering to claim the title of the largest market debut on record.

** Shares of South Korean chipmaker Samsung Electronics fell 1.64%, while peer SK Hynix lost 0.52%.

** Among other index heavyweights, battery maker LG Energy Solution slid 2.62%, while Hyundai Motor and sister automaker Kia Corp were down 2.43% and 1.84%, respectively.

** Steelmaker POSCO Holdings shed 1.53%, while drugmaker Samsung BioLogics fell 1.76%.

** Of the total 904 traded issues, 336 shares advanced, while 536 declined.

** Foreigners were net sellers of shares worth 162.6 billion won ($122.02 million).

** The won was quoted at 1,330.7 per dollar on the onshore settlement platform , 0.23% higher than its previous close at 1,333.7.

** The most liquid three-year Korean treasury bond yield (KR3YT=RR) fell 1.4 basis points to 3.732%, while the benchmark 10-year yield fell 1.0 basis points to 3.953%.

($1 = 1,332.5900 won)

data.title: Conveyor collapse kills three at India's NTPC Tandwa plant
data.description:
At least three workers were killed and four others were injured after a coal conveyor structure collapsed at NTPC's Tandwa project in Chatra district, Jharkhand, The New Indian Express reported on November 18.

The accident occurred at the plant's external Coal Handling Plant (CHP), where a section of the conveyor system gave way, trapping workers beneath the debris. Preliminary findings point to a possible structural design flaw in the conveyor belt system, although the exact cause of the collapse has yet to be established.

The project involved two external contractors. NTPC had awarded the conveyor belt construction contract to ThyssenKrupp, which subsequently engaged Simplex as a sub-contractor to execute the work, according to the newspaper.

Witnesses said the incident took place near Junction No. 1 of the conveyor system when a take-up trolley collapsed, striking workers in the vicinity.

Chatra Superintendent of Police Animesh Naithani confirmed that three workers had died in the accident. He said Tandwa police station officer-in-charge Vipin Kumar had reached the site with a police team soon after receiving information about the incident. Police personnel, administrative officials and rescue teams remained at the location as relief and rescue operations continued.

The accident prompted an immediate response from local authorities and NTPC's plant management, with rescue efforts launched to locate and assist those trapped in the wreckage.

The four injured workers were taken to NTPC Sanjeevani Hospital in Tandwa, where they are receiving medical treatment.

One of the deceased was identified as Rajendra Soni, also known as Raju, a resident of Tandwa. He had been associated with the company since 2019.

data.title: Indian shares set to open lower as hawkish Fed minutes weigh
data.description:
Indian shares are expected to open lower on Thursday as a hawkish tone from the US Federal Reserve in its latest policy meeting minutes threatens to overshadow optimism over easing crude oil prices and sustained foreign fund inflows.

GIFT Nifty futures (GIFc1) were at 25,161.5 points, as of 7:47 a.m. IST, indicating a negative start for the benchmark Nifty 50 index , which closed at 25,227.95 on Wednesday.

The October minutes of the Fed's meeting showed policymakers saw a need to intensify their efforts to control inflation, even as they agreed to keep interest rates steady for now.

"The (minutes) indicated that further interest rate increases could be warranted, with some policymakers even considering a hike larger than 25 basis points in December. The hawkish undertone could keep investors cautious as markets reassess the US monetary policy trajectory," said Ponmudi R, CEO at Enrich Money.

Higher US interest rates make the dollar and US Treasuries attractive for foreign portfolio investors (FPIs), which could draw capital away from emerging market equities.

FPIs have turned buyers in India this month after heavy selling in the last two years due to a lack of AI exposure and elevated oil prices.

They net bought shares worth 58.67 billion rupees ($627.69 million) on Wednesday, as per provisional data. Their purchases in India this month have surged to a record $11.28 billion.

Brent crude futures hovered around $92.5 per barrel, with the contract down 21.5% this month.

MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MISX00000PUS) was little changed after Claude chatbot maker Anthropic scored the biggest IPO ever with an $81 billion offering ahead of its market debut in a test for the AI trade that has been under pressure in recent weeks.

STOCKS TO WATCH

** National Aluminium Company signs pact with Russian aluminium producer Rusal to study the recovery of scandium from red mud, as India seeks more access to minerals used in advanced industry and clean energy

** Edtech company Physicswallah expects revenue between 90 billion rupees and 100 billion rupees by FY30, buoyed by steady demand for digital learning and test preparation services

** BLS Polymers' second-quarter profit more than doubles to 105.4 million rupees, while revenue rises 28.9% from last year

($1 = 93.4700 Indian rupees)

data.title: BOJ chief offers upbeat view on consumption despite recent weakness
data.description:
By Leika Kihara

Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Thursday consumption would likely recover after a temporary slowdown, adding that the drop in private spending seen in third-quarter gross domestic product (GDP) data was within the central bank's expectations.

"Nominal wages will rise steadily, while the pace of inflation is likely to gradually slow," Ueda told parliament, adding that rising household income would underpin consumption.

He also said consumption was resilient as a whole, with the drop seen in third-quarter GDP data resulting from rising cost of living and bad weather.

"We expect consumption to resume a moderate uptrend," he said, suggesting that soft third-quarter consumption alone would not prevent the BOJ from raising rates again in the near-term.

Ueda signalled the BOJ's vigilance to the inflationary impact of the weak yen, saying the currency's falls may cause an inflation overshoot by boosting prices for a wide range of goods.

"We are mindful of the risk that rising crude oil prices and yen declines, if they persist, could hurt households' real income and weigh on consumption more than expected," Ueda said.

On monetary policy, Ueda reiterated the central bank's resolve to keep raising interest rates, saying financial conditions remain loose despite past hikes.

"It's important to anchor underlying inflation around our 2% target to avoid risk of an inflation overshoot from materialising and hurting the economy," he said.

A majority of analysts polled by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise interest rates in December and follow up with another by end-March, as the central bank remains focused on inflation and a weak currency.

data.title: iA Financial Group Announces Offering of $500 million of 4.625% Fixed/Floating Unsecured Subordinated Debentures
data.description:
iA Financial Group (the “Company”) () announced today an offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 4.625% fixed/floating unsecured subordinated debentures (the “Debentures”) due November 24, 2036 (the “Offering”).

The Debentures will be issued as “Sustainable Bonds” under iA Financial Group’s 2026 Sustainability Bond Framework, published on November 17, 2026 (the “Framework”). The Framework is available on the Company’s website at ia.ca.

The Offering is expected to close on or about November 24, 2026. The Company intends to use an amount equal to the net proceeds from the sale of the Debentures to finance or re-finance, in part or in full, new and/or existing Eligible Assets within each of the Green Eligible Categories and Social Eligible Categories, all as defined in the Framework.

The Debentures will mature on November 24, 2036. Interest on the Debentures at the rate of 4.625% per annum will be payable in arrears in equal semi-annual installments on May 24 and November 24, in each year, commencing on May 24, 2027 and continuing until November 24, 2031. From November 24, 2031, interest on the Debentures will be payable at a rate per annum equal to Daily Compounded CORRA, plus 1.27% payable quarterly in arrears on the 24th day of each of February, May, August and November in each year, commencing on February 24, 2032.

The Offering is being done on a best efforts agency basis by a syndicate of agents led by National Bank of Canada Capital Markets, RBC Capital Markets and Scotiabank as co-leads and bookrunners, and including BMO Capital Markets, CIBC Capital Markets, TD Securities, iA Private Wealth Inc., Casgrain & Company Limited, Morgan Stanley Canada Limited and UBS Investment Bank. National Bank of Canada Capital Markets also acted as Sustainability Structuring Advisor on the Framework.

The Debentures will be offered in each of the provinces of Canada under a shelf prospectus supplement (the “Prospectus Supplement”) to the Company’s short form base shelf prospectus dated May 12, 2026 (the “Shelf Prospectus”).

Access to the Prospectus Supplement, the Shelf Prospectus and any amendments to the documents is provided in accordance with securities legislation relating to procedures for providing access to a shelf prospectus supplement, a base shelf prospectus and any amendment to the documents. The Shelf Prospectus is, and the Prospectus Supplement will be (within two business days), accessible on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.com.

An electronic or paper copy of the Prospectus Supplement, the Shelf Prospectus and any amendment to the documents may be obtained, without charge, from National Bank of Canada Capital Markets by contacting syndicate-corp@nbc.ca, RBC Capital Markets by contacting torontosyndicate@rbccm.com or Scotiabank by contacting syndicate.toronto@scotiabank.com, by providing the contact with an email address or address, as applicable.

Notice

This press release does not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy any security and shall not constitute an offer, solicitation or sale of any securities in any jurisdiction in which such offering, solicitation or sale would be unlawful.

The Debentures have not been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “U.S. Securities Act”) or the securities laws of any state of the United States of America, and may not be offered, sold or delivered, directly or indirectly, within the United States, its territories, its possessions and other areas subject to its jurisdiction or to, or for the account or benefit of, U.S. persons (as defined in Regulation S under the U.S. Securities Act), except in certain transactions exempt from, or not subject to, the registration requirements of the U.S. Securities Act and applicable state securities laws. This press release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any of these securities within the United States.

iA Financial Group is one of the largest insurance and wealth management groups in Canada, with operations in the United States. Founded in 1892, it is an important Canadian public company and is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol IAG (common shares).

data.title: Close the Loop Reaffirms Earnings Outlook with Lower Debt and Tighter Cost Maintenance
data.description:
Close the Loop has opened FY27 with $32.4 million in first-quarter revenue and $4.3m in EBITDA, as its two operating divisions returned positive contributions.

The recycling and sustainable packaging group reaffirmed its $14m to $16m EBITDA guidance for the year to June 2027 after both divisions contributed to the September-quarter result.

Australian resource recovery operations recorded their strongest first quarter in three years, benefiting from higher-margin programs and tighter cost controls.

Its balance sheet has undergone a sharper change, with net debt falling from $38.1m at 30 June to $16.3m at 30 September following the settlement of convertible notes.

A refinancing approved by Citi Bank promises a further lift to cash flow through lower interest costs and smaller scheduled debt repayments, although the agreement has yet to be completed.

Packaging Order Momentum

Packaging generated $18.6m in quarterly revenue, helped by new Australian customer wins and an order book extending into the second and third quarters.

South African reel-stock orders strengthened in September, although port delays pushed some revenue into later periods, while the New Zealand operation is now running as a standalone business.

“Over the past 12 months, we have realigned the group around our core strength, exited underperforming businesses that did not align with our profitability and return objectives, settled our convertible notes, and materially reduced net debt,” chair Grant Carman said.

“Our priorities are now to drive profitable growth, strengthen cash generation, reduce debt, and ensure each division has the leadership, capability, and clear accountability needed to deliver sustainable returns.”

A new sorting project and increased deliveries helped Resource Recovery generate $13.8m across its European operations, while US demand for recycled resin improved alongside processing capacity and automation, following the restructuring of the plastics recycling business.

Financial Breathing Room

Close the Loop settled $24.4m of convertible notes after the June year end by issuing 60.4 million shares, a move that accounted for much of the subsequent reduction in net debt.

The proposed replacement of its existing PGIM debt facility has now received Citi Bank approval, with documentation and completion targeted for mid-December.

On the terms outlined, the interest rate would fall by about 450 basis points and annual interest costs by approximately $1.4m, with smaller quarterly principal repayments freeing up additional cash for operations and debt reduction.

A further US$2.5m payment is expected when the transaction closes, adding another near-term consideration to the group’s cash planning.

Leadership Team Changes

The $14m to $16m FY27 EBITDA target represents projected growth of 13% to 29% on the previous financial year.

Capital expenditure is forecast at $1m to $3m, compared with $2.5m last year, as the group prioritises cash generation and profitable growth.

Changes to the board see Trifon Dimos become chair after the annual general meeting, with Mr Carman to remain as a non-executive director.

As the business moves beyond its recent restructuring, management is reviewing divisional leadership and resources while directing investment towards operations capable of generating sustainable returns.

data.title: Nalco signs pact with Russia’s Rusal to study recovery of scandium from red mud
data.description:
State-owned Nalco on Wednesday said it has partnered with Russian firm Rusal to study the recovery of scandium from red mud generated during alumina production.

As India intensifies efforts towards securing strategic mineral resources for emerging technologies and clean energy applications, the partnership is expected to facilitate knowledge exchange and evaluation of viable pathways for scandium recovery from red mud, Nalco said in an exchange filing.

Rusal, a leading firm in the global aluminium industry and the world's largest producer of low-carbon aluminium, has developed technology for the extraction of scandium from red mud, a by-product generated during alumina production, thereby presenting valuable opportunities for technology sharing and cooperation in the critical minerals sector.

An MoU was signed on the sidelines of the 44th International Conference and Exhibition ICSOBA 2026, Nalco said in the filing.

"National Aluminium Company Ltd... has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the RUSAL for collaboration in the recovery of the critical mineral Scandium from Red Mud," the PSU said.

The signing of the MoU took place in the presence of Nalco CMD Brijendra Pratap Singh; Jagdish Arora, Director (Projects & Technical); Viktor Mann, Technical Director, Rusal, and other senior officials of both firms.

National Aluminium Company Ltd is a 'Navratna' public sector undertaking (PSU) of the mines ministry. It is one of the country's largest bauxite, alumina, aluminium and power complex. Currently, the government owns a 51.28 per cent stake in Nalco.

data.title: Dalian iron ore snaps six-session losing streak on lower arrivals
data.description:
By Emily Ou Yong

Iron ore futures rose on Thursday, as lower port arrivals offered some support, though falling hot metal output and widening mill margin losses limited gains.

The most-traded January iron ore contract on China's Dalian Commodity Exchange (DCE) snapped a six-session losing streak to trade 0.78% higher at 650 yuan ($97.49) a metric ton, as of 0200 GMT.

The benchmark December iron ore <SZZFZ6> on the Singapore Exchange was 0.41% higher at $88.05 a ton.

Futures and spot prices rebounded together, with lower arrivals offering interim support, though a single-day gain does not establish stronger procurement demand, said analysts from Shanghai Metals Market (SMM) in a note.

Traders are holding offers firm, they said, but hot metal output continues to fall and port stocks remain high, keeping fundamental pressure in place.

Three blast furnaces were under maintenance this week, mainly in Hebei and Hubei provinces, while environmental curbs in Handan city remain in place and furnaces in the northwest are set to halt ahead of the winter break, pointing to a further decline in hot metal output, showed SMM data.

Key steel enterprises produced hot metal at an average of 1.82 million tons a day in October, down 3.8% from September and 5.9% lower in total output from a year earlier, data from the China Iron and Steel Association showed.

Losses at mainstream mills in key steelmaking hub Tangshan widened this week after a sharp fall in billet prices, with ordinary square billets at 2,810 yuan a ton ex-factory on November 18, data from consultancy Mysteel showed.

Other steelmaking ingredients on the DCE fell, with coking coal NYMEX:ACT1! and coke (DCJcv1) down 1.56% and 0.73%, respectively.

Steel benchmarks on the Shanghai Futures Exchange were mixed. Rebar rose 0.51% and hot-rolled coil gained 0.45%, while stainless steel fell 1.63%.

($1 = 6.6676 Chinese yuan)

data.title: ‘Nothing Wrong With NVDA Or AI Trade’: Kenny Polcari Says Fed’s Inflation Concerns Are The Bigger Market Risk
data.description:
Key points:
  • Polcari said that comments from the Fed and its policymakers have sparked inflationary concerns. 
  • Fed Governor Christopher Waller said in an interview on Wednesday that the central bank needs to “shock people” with at least a half-percentage-point interest rate hike in December as inflationary concerns continue to mount.
  • A day earlier, St. Louis Fed president Alberto Musalem said that the Federal Reserve may need several rate hikes to control inflation ​and should act soon. 

The Dow Jones Industrial Average and the S&P 500 took a beating on Wednesday, ending the session in red following weakness in the AI trade after the Federal Reserve’s minutes.

Kenny Polcari, Partner and Chief Market Strategist at SlateStone Wealth, said that the weakness in the indexes could not be blamed on Nvidia Corp.’s (NVDA) falling prices or the AI trade, noting that the Fed’s comments have sparked inflationary concerns.

In a post on X, Polcari said, “I am NOT buying the NVDA weakness as the reason for the weakness today in the Dow and S&P - You can blame Fed Gov Waller and Fed Pres Musalem for their predictions of more aggressive rate hikes. There is nothing wrong with NVDA or the AI trade - Come on! It's ridiculous.”

Fed Flags AI Risk 

The central bank’s policymakers called artificial intelligence “a material source of inflation risk” in their latest minutes from the October meeting, adding that “off-balance-sheet leasing commitments and circular financing arrangements among AI-related firms could amplify losses if returns on AI investment were to disappoint.”

“In the months ahead, almost all participants judged that, under their baseline outlooks for inflation and the labor market, further action to raise the target range for the federal funds rate,” the minutes said, “would likely be appropriate, in order to ensure a timely return of inflation to the 2% objective.”

Meanwhile, economist Peter Schiff said in a post on X, “Inflation has been the Fed's go-to policy tool. Whenever there was a problem in financial markets, the Fed created more inflation to solve it. But now too much inflation has itself become a problem. Will the Fed choose to worsen the inflation problem to bail out investors again?”

Policymakers See Further Hikes On The Cards

Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said in an interview with CNBC on Wednesday that the central bank needs to “shock people” with at least a half-percentage-point interest rate hike in the December meeting as inflationary concerns continue to mount.

“I’m very, very concerned about inflation. It’s kind of headed in the wrong direction, and it’s spreading out,” Waller said. “If you really want to get it down, you’ve got to start taking more aggressive actions.”

A day earlier, St. Louis Fed president Alberto Musalem said that the Federal Reserve may need several rate hikes to control inflation ​and should act soon.

"The economy will likely require several interest ​rate increases before the spring of 2027 ​to achieve price stability in a timely manner," ⁠Musalem said, noting that the current 3.75% to 4% target range is below the level it needs to be at to achieve the 2% inflation target.

Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco President Mary Daly also noted that further interest rate hikes will be needed to ensure inflation returns to the central bank's 2% target. However, Daly suggested adopting a more “measured pace” to evaluate shifting economic conditions.

How Is The Market Reacting?

The SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY), which tracks the S&P 500 index, was up 0.48% in the overnight session late Wednesday after closing in the red. Retail sentiment on Stocktwits was ‘bullish’ at the time of writing.

The Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) and the SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF Trust (DIA) also edged higher in the overnight session, with retail sentiment in the ‘bullish’ and ‘neutral’ territories respectively.

The iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) was down 0.03% amid ‘bullish’ sentiment.

data.title: Malaysia to review leaked Deutsche Bank 1MDB files, task force official says
data.description:
Malaysia is studying leaked files that allegedly show that Deutsche Bank ignored internal red flags to help move millions of dollars linked to fugitive financier Low Taek Jho, a senior official said on Wednesday.

News portal Malaysiakini reported that Deutsche Bank's correspondent banking service was used to facilitate at least 24 transactions worth €172.98 million that were linked to Low, a key player in the multibillion-dollar 1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal.

  • The portal cited leaked internal files from the "Inside Deutsche Bank" investigation, which covers more than 15 million files dating from the early 2010s

  • The report also stated that the bank continued to process millions of euros in transfers linked to Low in 2015, despite filing its own suspicious activity reports

  • Reuters was unable to independently verify the documents

  • A spokesperson for Deutsche Bank said in an email response that the bank has cooperated fully with regulatory and law enforcement authorities in relation to inquiries concerning 1MDB, and has not been subject to any regulatory penalty or sanction arising from 1MDB

  • "As stated in asset forfeiture complaints filed by the US Department of Justice, 1MDB made material misrepresentations and omissions to Deutsche Bank officials in connection with 1MDB’s transactions with the bank," the spokesperson said

  • The chairman of the task force in charge of recovering 1MDB assets, Johari Abdul Ghani, told Reuters that the relevant parties, including the task force itself and 1MDB's legal team, were now studying the information

  • However, he said it was still "premature" to comment on Malaysia's position while the court case against Deutsche Bank was ongoing

  • "Malaysia has pursued, and will continue to pursue, action against international banks which we believe failed to carry out proper customer due diligence checks in relation to the movement of 1MDB funds by Low, his associates and/or proxies," he said

  • 1MDB is currently in settlement talks with Deutsche Bank over the legal dispute

  • Low has previously denied wrongdoing, and his current whereabouts are unknown

data.title: Here's why shares of United Spirits, Radico Khaitan, Allied Blenders will be in focus today
data.description:
Shares of alcohol beverage companies, including United Spirits Ltd., Radico Khaitan Ltd. and Allied Blenders and Distillers Ltd., are expected to trade lower on Thursday, November 19, after India imposed an effective customs duty of 162.5% on bulk Scotch whisky imports from the UK.

The effective levy is higher than the 150% duty that applied before the India-UK free trade agreement (FTA) came into force in July. The trade pact had halved the tariff on Scotch imports to 75%, a move that was widely seen as a major boost for companies such as Pernod Ricard and Diageo, which import Scotch in bulk and blend it with other spirits to manufacture whisky in India.

However, the tariff reduction has now become the subject of a dispute between Indian authorities and liquor companies over the classification of bulk Scotch imports.

Indian investigators have argued that bulk Scotch concentrates used in the manufacture of blended whisky should be classified under a separate customs category introduced in May, known as ‘compound alcoholic preparations’. This category attracts a 150% tariff, along with an additional consumption tax, taking the effective duty to 162.5%, according to a Reuters report.

The dispute has resulted in thousands of litres of bulk Scotch being held up at Indian ports. More than 80 shipping containers belonging to Pernod Ricard, Diageo and Bacardi have been detained, Reuters reported last week.

Under a provisional release arrangement pending the investigation, companies are required to pay duty equivalent to 75% of the goods' value upfront, with the remaining amount covered by bank guarantees, the report said.

Pernod Ricard, which owns UK-based Chivas Brothers, Diageo and other liquor companies operating in India believe that both bulk and bottled Scotch imports should attract the 75% tariff agreed under the trade pact.

The British government has repeatedly said it is engaging with New Delhi to resolve the issue, while Indian authorities have indicated that the dispute will be settled soon.

Pernod Ricard and Diageo have moved to arrange bank guarantees and other funding to secure the release of their detained containers and minimise disruptions to business. Bacardi, meanwhile, is still evaluating its next steps, Reuters reported.

Around 80% of Scotch whisky imports from Britain by volume arrive in bulk, making the classification issue particularly significant for the industry. India is the world's largest market for Scotch whisky by volume.

A large share of bulk Scotch imports is used to manufacture Indian-made foreign liquor (IMFL) whisky. These products are made by blending a proportion of Scotch with other spirits and are typically priced well below fully imported brands such as Chivas Regal and Johnnie Walker.

Whisky tariffs had been a key sticking point during the prolonged negotiations leading up to the India-UK trade agreement, which came into force on July 15. The UK had said that iconic British products, including Scotch whisky, would benefit from the pact.

The Scotch Whisky Association has estimated that the trade agreement could boost Scotch exports to India by $1.34 billion over five years.

data.title: U.S. Offers $50 Million to Support Malaysia's Sovereign AI Cloud Initiative
data.description:
By Ying Xian Wong

KUALA LUMPUR--The U.S. plans to help develop Malaysia's sovereign artificial-intelligence cloud, including through the participation of U.S. technology firms.

President Donald Trump and Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced the cooperation on Wednesday.

Trump is in Shenzhen this week as part of his visit to China for Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meetings.

The U.S. indicated its intention to provided $50 million in financing for Malaysia's initiative, as well as technical assistance and training, the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission said.

The move comes as Malaysia seeks to establish itself as a regional AI hub, attracting billions of dollars in investment from global technology companies amid growing demand for computing power and cloud services.

In budget 2026, the government allocated 2 billion ringgit, or about $486 million, to establish the sovereign AI cloud, underscoring its push to build domestic AI infrastructure and ensure greater control over data and computing resources.

data.title: Why Is AMD Stock Rising Overnight?
data.description:
Key points:
  • OpenAI’s models helped deliver a 14% improvement in power, performance, and area (PPA) in AMD’s flagship chip design.
  • AMD stock rose over 0.3% in overnight trading, after gaining 5.3% in the regular session. 
  • Retail sentiment for AMD was ‘bullish’ as of late Wednesday.

OpenAI and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) on Wednesday hailed their collaboration, with the ChatGPT maker saying that its models helped improve AMD’s flagship chips.

The tweaks delivered up to a 14% improvement in power, performance, and area (PPA) over already optimized baselines for AMD’s flagship GPU design.

OpenAI described the work as roughly a year of chip-design progress achieved in less than five months, adding that AMD had already sent some model-designed changes for manufacturing.

Separately, commentators noted the use of AMD technology in ‘Grand Theft Auto VI,’ Rockstar Games’ highly anticipated title that was released overseas on Wednesday, giving another boost to the chipmaker’s market sentiment.

AMD shares rose 0.3% in overnight trading, after gaining 5.3% in the regular session.

How OpenAI Boosted AMD IP

The work focused on rewriting SystemVerilog, the code used to describe chip circuits, OpenAI detailed in a blog post. OpenAI models proposed changes to circuits that calculate, control operations and move data, with successful checks using Synopsys electronic design tools.

OpenAI said the same processes helped optimize its own custom inference chip, Jalapeño, and it is now applying the approach to third-party hardware.

“Proud of these fantastic results - @OpenAI + @AMD engineers pushing the frontiers of chip design together!” AMD CEO Lisa Su said in an X post.

OpenAI President Greg Brockman wrote: “roughly an additional year of progress on @AMD's chip achieved in less than 5 months using our models, with some of these results included in a design that's recently been taped out — unprecedented results at the frontier of chip design.”

AMD Tech Powered GTA 6 Image Upscaling

Rockstar told gaming and tech news site Wccftech that ‘GTA VI’ uses AMD’s FSR 4 upscaling on Xbox Series S. The game renders at 720p, and then FSR rebuilds the image at 1080p.

The Series S is the only console version confirmed to use AMD’s machine-learning upscaler and also supports ray-traced global illumination (RTGI), according to Wccftech.

AMD introduced FSR Upscaling 4.1.2 for Xbox Series X and Series S developers earlier this month through the Xbox Game Development Kit.

Retail View On AMD

On Stocktwits, the retail sentiment for AMD remained ‘bullish,’ unchanged from the previous day.

“AMD Another big success in a row for AMD. In the Grand Theft Auto (GTA) game that is breaking and will break all records, the processors, graphics cards, console chips, and image-scaling technologies are the work of AMD—setting new standards unattainable for the vast majority,” said a trader.

Another wrote: $AMD is going to be the next NVDA. Lisa please take us to join the 5T club.”

Year to date, AMD stock is up 148%.
